description: FFB fresh fruit bunch detection and maturity classification dataset manifest

sources.name: roboflow_v1
sources.notes: Recorded v1 handoff metrics report four maturity classes only. Source class mapping and exact dataset version require teammate confirmation.

label_notes: Labels represent internal training standard. Source datasets may use different label schemes; importers handle the mapping.

split_strategy.constraint: Same tree, video, or mission images must stay in same split
split_strategy.notes: Test set should simulate truly unseen plantation blocks when possible

notes: raw layer accepts any format from any source
importers convert raw data into unified processed format
This manifest is a conversion spec, not a gate for excluding non-standard datasets
FFB offline v1 metrics are recorded but not integrated into AI Engine runtime
